title: feat: Add keyword search functionality within post/reel comments
summary: ### What should it do? Add a search bar or filter icon inside the comments section of Instagram posts and reels. This feature would allow users to enter a specific keyword or phrase to instantly filter and jump directly to the comments containing that word. ### Where in Instagram? Feed ### What happens today? Currently, Instagram does not provide any built-in option to search or filter comments within a post or reel. To find a comment containing a specific keyword, users have to manually scroll through hundreds or thousands of comments, which is tedious and often impractical on viral posts. ### Why does it matter? Popular posts and reels often have thousands of comments. Currently, finding a specific comment, reference, song name, or context mentioned in the comment section requires endless manual scrolling, which is time-consuming and frustrating. Adding an in-comment search feature would make navigating large comment threads much faster and improve the overall user experience. ​Proposed implementation / Behavior ​Add a search icon at the top of the comments sheet/bottom drawer. ​Tapping the search icon opens a text input field to type keywords. ​Dynamically filter loaded comments or scroll/highlight matching comments containing the searched keyword (with next/previous navigation arrows if multiple matches exist). ### Before you send it - [x] I searched the open and closed feature requests and this isn't one of them.
